diagnosis: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell (pDC) proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
legend: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows biphasic morphology of the blasts: the larger population consisting of myeloid blasts and the smaller one of pDCs with protrusions (Giemsa) (<<36187>>). Anti-CD34 immunohistochemistry shows increased blasts (<<36405>>). Anti-CD123 immunohistochemical staining shows interstitial distribution of pDCs (<<36406>>), as well as an aggregate of pDCs (<<36190>>).

diagnosis: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation in the bone marrow
